cost_model_assumptions.basis: Comparable replacement-capital model per IT GW
notes: Epoch's common model prices the same dollars per IT watt across hardware generations; company differences therefore arise through H100e density, not a claimed vendor-specific procurement discount.
Replacement capital is not book value, historical cash capex or a valuation floor.
Observed project, lease, hardware and service benchmarks are kept in separate layers and must not be added without a full scope bridge.
The 'future indicator' column is not uniformly incremental: it mixes signed customer demand, contracted supply and internal target-state projects; its basis is carried company by company.
